scoring_justification: Headline activation energy is recomputed by finding the minimum-energy path on the supplied grid and measuring the barrier; HF2- dissociation barrier is recomputed via saddle-point analysis on its grid; equilibrium bond length is extracted from the binding curve.

steps.description: Equilibrium Si-F bond length from binding curve minimum (paper Fig.3)
HF2- dissociation barrier and saddle-point geometry (paper Fig.4)
Energy ordering: surface without H+ should be higher than or equal to surface with H+ at matching grid points
Desorption activation energy from MEP on surface with H+ attack (paper Fig.5, text)
Reported summary values consistent with paper references
Monotonic angle decrease and bond population collapse along reaction coordinate; with H+ case steeper (paper Fig.7)

outputs.description: Computed total electronic energy of an isolated SiF4 molecule as a function of the Si-F bond length. The checker extracts the equilibrium bond length from this curve.
Potential energy surface for HF2- dissociation. The checker locates the saddle point and computes the dissociation barrier.
Desorption energy surface computed without hydrogen attack. Used for reference and trend comparisons.

Desorption energy surface computed with explicit H+ attack. The checker extracts the transition state and activation energy from this surface. Load-bearing: cannot be fabricated without running the core calculation.

required.angle_range: list of two floats (min, max) in deg
required.bond_population_range: list of two floats (max, min) dimensionless

outputs.description: Summary report containing the extracted key quantities. Checked against hidden reference values with tolerances.

Trend of O-Si-F angle and Si-O bond population along the minimum-energy desorption path, for both H+ conditions. Checker verifies monotonic decrease in angle and population, with steeper collapse for the with_Hplus case.

output_contract.notes: All energies are in eV, lengths in Å, angles in degrees. The desorption surface with H+ is the principal scored artifact; its activation energy must be derived from the computed grid. The angle and population trend must show the expected monotonic behavior (angle decreasing from ~109.47° to ~70.53°, population falling to zero). The checker does not require reproducing exact experimental values; it compares against the paper's own computed results.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for SiF4 equilibrium bond length, HF2- dissociation barrier and saddle geometry, desorption activation energy, transition state coordinates, angle and population ranges
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.3 (SiF4 equilibrium), Fig.4 (HF2- dissociation barrier/saddle r), Fig.5 and text (desorption activation energy and transition state coordinates), Fig.7 (angle and population evolution).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually transcribed from the paper's reported computed values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All numbers are exactly the paper's publicly stated computational results.
